name: Premier Inn Liverpool City Centre (Moorfields) hotel

reviews.title: Very Enjoyable stay in liverpool
reviews.text: Really nice hotel. parking in the NCP was directly across from the hotel. Good location, close to the cavern quarter.  Very friendly and cheerful staff which made our stay extremely enjoyable. will differently return in the summer time

reviews.title: Overnight stay
reviews.text: Second time we have stayed here.  We were impressed the first time and we were not disappointed when we returned.  The friendly and helpful staff do a great job.  The rooms are clean, beds comfy and tea and coffee is available in the room.  Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Pleasant stay spoiled by item taken from room!
reviews.text: We had a pleasant stay at this hotel unfortunately my wife's bath robe was taken from our room and the staff made us feel as if they were giving us the "run around" rather than trying to find the bathrobe.

reviews.title: Exellent stay
reviews.text: Had a very enjoyable stay in the premier inn staff very polite and efficient cleaning lady very helpful and reception staff very quick check in and out .rooms spotless and comfy bed only thing was the noise from the traffic outside

reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: Can not fault the hotel or staff! Top notch facilities! Very clean! And very secure. Had a lovely experience at this hotel! Staff couldn’t do anymore to help if they tried! Keep up the good work! Very impressed!
